name: ChartLegend
description:
Series identity for two or more series (a single series needs no legend: the title names
it). Interactive at the full tier: each item toggles its series (aria-pressed); the legend
is one tab stop and the arrow keys move between items (R11.5). Keyboard focus emphasises
a series the same way hover does. The last visible series cannot be hidden, so the chart
is never empty by accident; its tooltip and description say why.
signature: ({ items, hidden, onToggle, layout, active, onActive, className }: ChartLegendProps): import("react").JSX.Element

props.name: className
props.description: Classes applied to the outer element for layout. Use the component props and theme tokens for its appearance.

props.name: items
props.description: The collection rendered by the component. Stable identifiers preserve selection and keyboard focus.

props.name: layout
props.description: `row`: one line in the head, truncating; `list`: a column with values (pie, donut).

props.name: onActive
props.description: Called when active occurs. The callback type specifies its arguments.

props.name: onToggle
props.description: Makes the legend a toolbar of toggles (full tier). Omit for a passive key.
